title: Fantastic Monument and Lovely Guide
text: We met Victoria at the monument of Isabelle and Columbus, we set off promptly and she explained the history of the town and narrow streets leading to the Cathedral and Chapels. She was friendly and very knowledgeable. We asked lots of questions and she was able to confidently answer. The cathedral and chapels was the add on trip as we came to Granada because of the Alhambra. However, this tour and the buildings we visited were absolutely stunning. We were very fortunate that the Cathedral had an exhibition of the floats that are carried during Holy week. I have been to numerous holy weeks para
author: Louise_K

title: Our guide knew so much,...

title: Five stars!
text: The guide was outstanding, very knowledgeable and friendly. The walking pace worked for us.  I will be reading up on Isabella and king, it was so interesting.

title: Fabulous!!!

author: N4167DSlorenzor

title: A tour that must be booked
text: This is a must see tour! The Granada Cathedral is one of the most spectacular cathedrals I have seen in my four years of traveling Europe. The Royal chapel is important to see where the famous monarchs, King Ferdinand II and Queen Isabella I are buried.
author: Jeffrey_B

title: Professional guide, excellent experience
text: Tour guide Marta Soler provided us with professional and detailed guiding services, introducing us to various knowledge about the Cathedral and the Royal Chapel during the more than two-hour tour, and enthusiastically answering our questions. A pleasant memory!
author: DayTrip40892969719

title: Great tour

title: To give a real-name commendation to Ms. Marta Soler for the guided tour service of the Granada Cathedral and Royal Chape
text: A very good experience, our guide Marta Soler was very responsible, her explanations were professional and detailed, and she actively answered all our questions. A pleasant journey of almost 3 hours. 😊
